title: LuckRead Subscription D1-01 Logical Persistence Contract

authority.workerRuntimeBoundary: W07 Subscription workflow with explicitly admitted D1-01 access transition; W02 remains D1-01 Identity/Account/Access authority owner.

table.name: membership_subscriptions
table.purpose: Authoritative durable Subscription lifecycle state for Membership/Subscription access.

constraints.subscriptionIdUnique: subscription_id is the primary key and is never reused.
constraints.subscriberReference: subscriber_id references authoritative ENT-USER by stable identifier only; no cross-D1 physical foreign key.
constraints.planVersionReference: plan_id + plan_version identifies the immutable plan definition consumed by the subscription.
constraints.financialIsolation: No payment, order, ledger, wallet or settlement facts are persisted as Subscription authority.
constraints.entitlementIsolation: entitlement_snapshot_ref is a reference only; Entitlement remains its own authority.
constraints.privacy: subscriber_id is not a public identifier and must be exposed only through authorized scoped APIs.

concurrency.apiBoundary: If-Match / expected-version semantics from Membership API contract.
concurrency.decision: The current Entity field contract has no standalone version field. A later admission must bind the HTTP concurrency token to an already-authoritative version source without inventing a duplicate lifecycle field.

uniqueness.reason: Membership Data Contract requires prevention of duplicate active subscriptions where business policy requires it, but the authoritative policy does not yet define whether the business key is subscriber-only, subscriber+plan, creator scope, organization scope, or another combination.
uniqueness.rule: No speculative unique constraint may be introduced until the applicable Membership policy/plan scope contract resolves the active-subscription uniqueness boundary.

migration.rule: A physical migration requires a separate admitted migration contract, exact artifact hash, controlled target D1-01 execution and post-schema evidence.

forbidden: Add a second Subscription authority in D1-04.
Store payment-provider secrets or raw payment credentials.
Create a speculative active-subscription uniqueness constraint.
Introduce a standalone version field without a field-contract change.
Treat cache, projection or analytics data as Subscription authority.
Execute or claim migration success from this logical contract.
verificationRequirements: schema inspection proving all 13 columns and nullability
Evidence Registry record tied to validating commit SHA
promotionRule: Remain CONTRACTED_NOT_VERIFIED until the physical binding, migration, runtime authority and Evidence Registry evidence are all admitted.
